What this map measures

Every point is a real 2,048-value residual activation at the last context position, after transformer block 8 (zero-based). It precedes the token shown in the inspector. The first point is captured at the end of prefill; earlier prompt positions are not recorded.

Eight landmarks are averages of activations from 48 fixed reference prompts. PCA supplies three saved axes. The map never refits or rescales between runs. Similarities use the original 2,048 dimensions, not screen distance. Low “3D retains” means most variation is outside this view. Similarity bars span −1 to +1; they are not probabilities.

These are descriptive reference matches, not discovered SAE features, named neurons, a chain of thought, or causal explanations. Labels were assigned to reference examples by the developer. A point can fall outside every reference category.

The live model runs in a worker in your browser using a pinned ONNX export. Greedy decoding, 512 prompt tokens, 128 output tokens. Each prompt starts a fresh context. Model files download from Hugging Face; your prompt and measurements stay in the browser. Saved traces contain your prompt and response. WebGPU and shader-f16 are required for live mode. Live iPhone performance has not been verified. Recordings were produced on a CPU and are labeled separately. Imported traces are not authenticated.

At most three runs are retained. Lines mean temporal succession, not causal connections. Source and research
